dispatch.Clang without __AVX2__: distance-only n>=32; paths n>=16; runtime AVX2 required
dispatch.Clang with __AVX2__: distance-only retains original automatic vectorization; paths SIMD at n>=16

summary.correctness: 9 configurations, each 30126 random graphs plus boundaries and path/overflow/negative-cycle oracle; no warnings
summary.sanitizer_note: ASan+UBSan passed with detect_leaks=0 because host LeakSanitizer fails under ptrace
algorithm_notes: Four int64 relaxations per AVX2 iteration; signed comparisons implement min and lower clamp.
Unreachable through lanes are masked out; their modulo SIMD addition never affects distance or path.
Path updates use the same strict-improvement mask and preserve tie behavior.
Wide arithmetic and output/negative-cycle handling retain original scalar logic.
SIMD wrapper is not inlined into caller, keeping register pressure and scalar tiny path close to original.
limitations: Times are library-only local measurements with identical bench source; no online result inferred.
Some tiny kernels differ by a few ns; exact non-regression for every input/CPU cannot be asserted.
Clang native DAG n128 measured +2.6% vs baseline, but identical baseline control +3.5%; sparse n32 +71ns (+5.9%) vs baseline with baseline-control variation -46ns.
SIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD removes intrinsic headers and runtime dispatch; executable .text matches original baseline for all four compiler/ISA combinations.
